boundary_statement: The item is the Telematics Cloud Backend — comprising the cloud backend services, Vehicle Data Ingestion API, Authentication and Identity Service, Diagnostic Command Log Store, and Technician Web Portal. The item boundary ends at the telematics-to-vehicle gateway interface; in-vehicle ECUs (including the BCM) are outside this item's scope.

decisions.rationale: Core cloud backend — explicitly named in the boundary statement as the primary item.
Vehicle Data Ingestion API is part of the cloud backend and sits within the item boundary.
BCM is a vehicle ECU downstream of the telematics gateway — outside the cloud item boundary per the boundary statement.
Technician Web Portal is explicitly named in the boundary statement.
Authentication and Identity Service is explicitly named in the boundary statement.
Diagnostic Command Log Store is explicitly named in the boundary statement.
